description: Hard voting ensemble combining Logistic Regression and LinearSVC predictions. Base models are trained fold-local on group-respecting out-of-fold training splits; final prediction is majority vote (ties resolved by stable label order). Soft voting (probability-averaged) is also computed as a diagnostic.
feature_representation: fold-local word unigram/bigram TF-IDF (max_features=60000, min_df=2, max_df=0.99, sublinear_tf=True)
ensemble_rule: Hard majority vote; ties resolved by stable LABELS order [Risky, Neutral, Safe]
artifact_note: Voting is a deterministic combination of base predictions; no separate fitted artifact is saved. Base model artifacts can be saved via the Linear SVM / Logistic Regression entry points. Production release is models/releases/linear-svc-primary-v2/.
